name: vitanaland
description: Put your business on Vitanaland, a health and longevity community marketplace: create the business, fill in company details and add products or services from a conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Set up your business on Vitanaland
interface.longDescription: Vitanaland is a health and longevity community marketplace. With this plugin a supplier can set up their business from a conversation: create the business, add company details, add products or services as hidden drafts, run the automatic business checks, connect an online shop and submit the business for review. The supplier signs in to their own Vitanaland account. Accepting the Partner Terms and everything that needs identity documents or payment details happens on Vitanaland, never in the chat.
